narrative.overview: A calm design archive made from paper-toned surfaces, sharp black type, restrained blue signals, and fine rules. Product hierarchy and predictability outrank spectacle, and the active preview remains dominant.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-toned flat surfaces with carbon-black type
Blue reserved for current selection, focus, and primary actions
Large editorial headings paired with compact monospaced metadata
Hairline rules and whitespace instead of nested containers
Familiar controls with complete keyboard and responsive behavior

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is the only decorative accent and occupies less than ten percent of a screen.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Sans explains the interface; mono reports the filesystem.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: If an element does not physically float above scrolling content, it does not receive a shadow.

dos: Do keep the preview as the largest and highest-contrast working object.
Do use Signal Blue only for actions, selection, focus, and state.
Do derive spacing, type, and radius from the shared tweak-token contract.
donts: Don't make this look like a generic SaaS dashboard.
Don't use decorative purple or multicolor gradients.
Don't use glassmorphism, floating 3D objects, or decorative blobs.
Don't wrap every project, page, and toolbar in rounded cards.
